explication: DockPanel is a self-hosted Linux server-management panel: users manage hosting and operations through a React interface, whose API is served by a Rust backend; the backend can delegate machine-level work to a per-server Rust agent. The sampled database route demonstrates backend-to-agent delegation, while README capabilities establish broader hosting, deployment, backup, security, and monitoring branches. Several route families are represented by their existing directories because their implementations were not sampled; unverified UI/backend links are dashed.
